limits: Targeted microbenchmarks, not whole-program speedup claims.
All six Wasm artifacts are byte-identical; their timing changes are not attributed to optimization.
All 25 existing kernel objects and eight example objects are byte-identical in both process pairs. Example optimized LLVM IR is also identical.

voice_bank example host/JIT timing initially rose 8.2% despite identical MIR, optimized LLVM IR and emitted objects. Three fresh process pairs changed direction (see voice_followup); the timings are not used to claim a change in generated-code performance. No whole-suite runtime gain is claimed.
Compile and JIT timings are retained but not used to claim compilation improvements.
View sets retain up to 16 alternatives per state object; unknown offsets, nested aggregate projections and analysis-budget exhaustion remain conservative.
